Kate Green

Deputy Mayor of Greater Manchester Kate Green

Kate Green was appointed as Deputy Mayor of Greater Manchester with responsibility for Safer and Stronger Communities in January 2023. She was reappointed on 12th August 2026 by the Mayor of Greater Manchester, Bev Craig. From 2010 to 2022, she served as the Member of Parliament for Stretford and Urmston. She is a member of the board of governors at Manchester Metropolitan University, sits on the Science and Industry Museum Advisory Board, the board of the Independent Custody Visiting Association, and is a trustee of Manchester Camerata.

Mark Llewellin DL

High Sheriff of Greater Manchester

Faith communities, civic leaders and neighbours gathered for an evening of poetry, music, dance, prayer and shared food

Representatives of many faiths and cultures came together in Bolton for the Interfaith Reception organised by the Bolton Branch of the Dialogue Society. The evening was full of warmth, smiles and conversation, and it showed what a community can achieve when its members meet with openness and respect.
